+root = true
+
+[*]
+charset = utf-8

+trim_trailing_whitespace = true

+indent_size = 2

+

+

@@ -0,0 +1,139 @@
+#:schema https://wstein.github.io/cx-cli/schemas/cx-config-v1.schema.json
+# cx works in three cooperating paths:
+#   proof:     bundle, extract, list, validate, verify
+#   live:      mcp
+#   adapter:   adapter, render
+# See: cx --help.
+schema_version = 1
+project_name = "gramaire"
+source_root = "."
+output_dir = "~/Downloads/gramaire-bundle"
+
+[output.extensions]
+xml = ".xml.txt"
+json = ".json.txt"
+markdown = ".md"
+plain = ".txt"
+
+[repomix]
+style = "xml"
+show_line_numbers = false
+include_empty_directories = false
+security_check = true
+
+[files]
+# [files].include extends the master candidate list beyond VCS-tracked files.
+# Keep it empty when VCS is the source of truth; add patterns here only for
+# generated or deliberately git-ignored files that should be eligible to pack.
+include = []
+exclude = [
+	".git/**",
+	".idea/**",
+	".metals/**",
+	".scala-build/**",
+	"**/node_modules/**",
+	"**/coverage/**",
+	"**/target/**",
+	"dist/**",
+	"site/dist/**",
+	"site/.astro/**",
+	"site/test-results/**",
+	"tmp/**"
+]
+follow_symlinks = false
+unmatched = "ignore"
+
+[dedup]
+# mode = "fail" aborts bundling if any file matches multiple section globs.
+# This guarantees deterministic ownership in the manifest.
+# Override locally with: cx --lenient bundle
+# Or scope per-section by tightening section globs.
+# Docs: README.md
+mode = "fail"
+order = "config"
+require_explicit_ownership = false
+
+[manifest]
+format = "json"
+pretty = true
+include_file_sha256 = true
+include_output_sha256 = true
+include_output_spans = true
+include_source_metadata = true
+
+# Set pretty = false to produce compact single-line manifests (smaller files, CI-friendly).
+
+[handover]
+include_repo_history = true
+repo_history_count = 25
+
+[mcp]
+# The MCP server is the live workspace path: agents read live state and may
+# mutate files only when explicitly authorized. policy="default" keeps mutation
+# bounded; use "unrestricted" only for trusted local sessions.
+policy = "default"
+# policy = "unrestricted"
+audit_logging = true
+enable_mutation = true
+
+[scanner]
+mode = "warn"
+ids = ["reference_secrets"]
+include_post_pack_artifacts = false
+
+[checksums]
+algorithm = "sha256"
+file_name = "{project}.sha256"
+
+[tokens]
+encoding = "o200k_base"
+
+[assets]
+include = []
+exclude = []
+mode = "copy"
+target_dir = "assets"
+layout = "flat"
+
+[sections.repo]
+include = [
+	"README.md",
+	"LICENSE",
+	"NOTICE",
+	"Makefile",
+	"build.sbt",
+	"package.json",
+	".editorconfig",
+	".gitattributes",
+	".gitignore",
+	".gitmodules",
+	".markdownlint-cli2.jsonc",
+	".markdownlint.json",
+	".mcp.json",
+	".scalafmt.conf",
+	"cx.toml",
+	"cx-mcp.toml",
+	"cx-mcp-build.toml",
+	"**/*.scala",
+	"**/*.sbt",
+	"**/*.md",
+	"**/*.astro",
+	"**/*.ts",
+	"**/*.tsx",
+	"**/*.js",
+	"**/*.mjs",
+	"**/*.cjs",
+	"**/*.json",
+	"**/*.toml",
+	"**/*.yml",
+	"**/*.yaml",
+	"**/*.sh",
+	"**/*.txt"
+]
+
+# -- Audited overrides -------------------------------------------------
+# cx never silently ignores a strict gate; it records the override.
+#
+#   cx --lenient bundle      # downgrade fail to warn for this run
+#   cx bundle --force        # bundle a dirty tree; manifest records forced_dirty
+#   cx bundle --ci           # same, marked ci_dirty for pipeline provenance
